# The frozen releases: a release the channel still serves and that nothing builds any more. Its tree stays as it is
# (nothing pruned without a separate decision), and a promotion (promote-staged/collect.py) does not hold it against
# its matrix. One per line: the package kind and the Fedora release or Debian suite as the channel names it.
# This list is the only place it is written.
# fc44: owner ruling 2026-11-19, every machine is on Fedora 45 (docs/release-operations.md).
rpm 44
# bookworm: owner ruling 2026-11-16, no release is built for Debian bookworm; what is published stays served.
deb bookworm
